import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def save_figure(fig, name):
    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), name)
    fig.savefig(path, dpi=150)
    size = os.stat(path).st_size
    print("saved", name, size, "bytes")
    return size


x = np.linspace(0, 6.28, 80)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3))
ax.plot(x, np.sin(x))
ax.set_xlabel("x")
ax.set_ylabel("sin(x)")
save_figure(fig, "out_sine.png")

lib-zero-arg-no-main.title: 文件里只有零参出图函数 make_figure()，没有 __main__ 调用；保存辅助函数 savefig 后 os.stat 读回

files.figlib.py:
import os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "lib_out.png")


def _save(fig, path):
    fig.savefig(path, dpi=150)
    return os.stat(path).st_size


def make_figure():
    x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3))
    ax.plot(x, np.cos(x) * np.exp(-x / 6))
    ax.set_title("damped cosine")
    _save(fig, OUT)
    return fig

lib-needs-data-arg.title: figlib.py 只有要数据参数的出图函数，真入口是同目录的 run_report.py（ADR 0188）；目标是 figlib.py

files.figlib.py:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def plot_series(xs, ys, title="series"):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3))
    ax.plot(xs, ys, marker="o")
    ax.set_title(title)
    return fig


def plot_hist(values, bins=8):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3))
    ax.hist(values, bins=bins)
    return fig
files.run_report.py:
import csv
from figlib import plot_series, plot_hist

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("data.csv")))
xs = [float(r["x"]) for r in rows]
ys = [float(r["y"]) for r in rows]
plot_series(xs, ys, "report")
plot_hist(ys)

files.fig.py:
import argparse
import csv
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument("--data", required=True, help="csv with x,y columns")
p.add_argument("--title", default="run")
args = p.parse_args()
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(args.data)))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4, 3))
ax.plot([float(r["x"]) for r in rows], [float(r["y"]) for r in rows])
ax.set_title(args.title)
